purpose: LinkedIn-style posting with responsibilities, perks, requirements, bonus points and a company blurb interleaved; alternatives in one bullet (Python or Scala; Spark, Flink or Beam; BigQuery, Snowflake or Redshift), years of experience, and a soft requirement written as a sentence. The CV is a two-column PDF (cv.html rendered by scripts/eval/pdf.ts) whose text layer is what cv.txt holds: the two-column reading order is part of what the text arm sees.

requirements.why: POSTING COUNT: six bullets under What you bring; the Python-or-Scala-and-SQL bullet may be split in two.
Alternatives inside one bullet are not requirements of their own.
